job.organization: Los Angeles County Office of Education

items.item_text: 01. Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification. Referring to your application/resume will NOT qualify as a response to any question, so please answer each question thoroughly. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application to be considered. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw from the application process for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is the highest level of education you have completed? (Please attach your degree or unofficial transcripts to your application.) Options: High school diploma or equivalent | Some college coursework | Associate's degree | Bachelor's degree | Master's degree | Doctorate degree

03. Please provide the title, field of study (as stated on your diploma), and the institution of the highest-level degree you have earned. Please state "NA" if you do not have a diploma, degree, or equivalent.

04. How many years of experience do you have in developing, implementing, and managing a countywide Foster Youth Services Coordinating Program? Options: None | Less than one year | 1 year but less than 2 years | 2 years but less than 3 years | 3 years but less than 4 years | 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 years or more

05. Describe your experience in developing, implementing, and managing a countywide Foster Youth Services Coordinating Program. Please provide specific examples. Be sure to include the name of the organization(s), job title(s), employment dates and your responsibilities as related to the experience mentioned above. Please state “NA” if you do not have the experience. Do not ask to refer to your application or resume.

06. How many years of experience do you have in in providing training and technical assistance to foster youth programs in collaboration with the California Department of Education (CDE)? Options: None | Less than one year | 1 year but less than 2 years | 2 years but less than 3 years | 3 years but less than 4 years | 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 years or more

07. Describe your experience in in providing training and technical assistance to foster youth programs in collaboration with the California Department of Education (CDE). Please provide specific examples. Be sure to include the name of the organization(s), job title(s), employment dates, and your responsibilities as related to the experience mentioned above. Please state “NA” if you do not have the experience. Do not ask to refer to your application or resume.
